newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel, Palestinian economic talks to resume.
newsitem.headline: Israel, Palestinian economic talks to resume.

text.p: Economic talks between the Palestinians and Israel will be renewed this week following a hiatus of over two months, Israel's Treasury said on Monday.

A series of meetings will be held this week by working committees to resolve certain outstanding issues, including trade restrictions, tax transfers and the Palestinian Authority's debt with Israeli organisations and companies.
No further details on the talks were available.
